_about: What each character does and how strong it is. Read once at startup (game/Directives.hx). Change numbers here, not in code. Every client in a multiplayer match must use the same file. Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored.

captain._role: Leader and the only one who can plant the flag. Losing him loses the game, so he lands last, stays at the back of the band, and steps away from enemies unless ordered forward.
captain._landsLast: Comes ashore after everyone else, once the beach is held.
captain._standBack: Metres behind the band's rally point when it gathers.
captain._evadeRadius: Steps back toward his own band when an enemy fighter comes this close, unless he's been ordered somewhere.
captain._takesCover: When an archer aims at him, he pulls back behind his band, out of arrow range (unless ordered somewhere).

bodyguard._role: Every soldier's first duty: protect the captain. When an enemy comes near him, or aims at him from range, soldiers within callRange drop what they're doing (unless the player ordered them) and go for that enemy.
bodyguard._threatRadius: An enemy this close to the captain is a threat.
bodyguard._callRange: Soldiers this close to the captain answer the call.

swordsman._role: Shield and blade. Closes in fast; strong against archers, weaker against pikes.

piker._role: Long reach. Holds a line; strong against swordsmen.

archer._role: Shoots from range and backs away from blades and pikes. Strong against pikers and the captain, weak against shields.
archer._kiteRadius: Steps back when a melee enemy comes this close.

combat._advantage: Damage multiplier, attacker vs defender. Unlisted pairs are 1.0.
combat._leash: A unit gives up a chase (unless ordered) when its target gets this far away.

march._rule: Once the captain (who lands last) is ashore, the band marches on the summit as a flock (boids: separation, alignment, cohesion, plus a pull along a walking path round water), captain at the rear. Units still fight anything they meet, then rejoin. Any order you give a unit takes it out of the march. It ends when the band is within arriveRadius of the summit.
march._perception: How far (m) a marcher sees its neighbours for alignment and cohesion.
march._separation: Marchers closer than this (m) push apart.
march._captainBack: How far (m) behind the band's centre the captain marches (4 m put him inside the melee when bands met).
march._captainHalt: The captain stops marching and holds when an enemy comes this close; the band fights on. Just beyond arrow range: four archers focusing him kill him in seconds.

flag._rule: A captain standing within range of the summit for raiseTime seconds, with no enemy within contest, plants his flag. It must then stand for holdTime seconds to win. Meanwhile the enemy captain can reach the summit and lower it (lowerTime seconds, same range and contest rules), which resets the clock; then either side can raise theirs.
flag._contest: Raising or lowering pauses while an enemy is this close to the summit.

ship._role: One per side. It carries the band, heals anyone back aboard, and fires its cannons on its own (like the characters' AI). If it sinks, everyone aboard goes down with it.
ship._boardRange: Select units and click your own ship: they walk to the shore nearest it and climb aboard (wade out) once it lies still within this many metres. They land again with its next landing order.
ship._healPerSecond: Hit points a character regains each second aboard (a badly hurt swordsman is whole again in about half a minute).

cannon._rule: Each ship fires one ball at a time from whichever broadside faces the target: enemy characters ashore (it prefers where they bunch up) or the enemy ship. Balls are lobbed, so they land where they were aimed: a character who walks on is missed. Accuracy falls with distance (scatter = scatter + scatterPerMetre x range), and nothing past range is fired at. At anchor a ship swings round to bring its guns to bear.
cannon._minRange: Too close to depress the guns (and it would hit its own landing party).
cannon._damage: To characters at the point of impact, falling to half at the edge of the splash. Never hurts its own side.
cannon._shipDamage: To a hull it lands within hullRadius of. 300 hp: about 8 hits sink a ship.
cannon._scatter: Metres a ball can land from its aim: 0.5 + 0.08 x distance, so about 1.3 m at 10 m and 3.7 m at 40 m.
cannon._broadside: Degrees either side of the beam a gun can point (guns are along the sides, none fore or aft).
